items.question: What document does the authority issue to confirm the closure of a company in a UAE free zone?
items.gold: A final de-registration certificate confirming the company's closure.
items.fact: Free zone closure ends with final de-registration certificate issuance.

items.question: When closing a branch of a free zone company whose parent company is not registered with the Ministry of Economy and Tourism, what must be provided?
items.gold: An attested decision of the parent company to cancel the free zone company branches.
items.fact: Unregistered parent requires attested parent decision to cancel branches.
